description: Place an EXISTING audio asset (a generated voiceover, a music track, any audio URL) on the timeline at a specific point so it's in the render. duration defaults to the full movie length (ideal for background music); pass sourceDuration for a fixed clip like a voiceover. Get a voiceover url/durationSec from get_project (project.voiceover / voiceovers[]). Blocked in read-only mode.

duration.description: Seconds. Defaults to movie length, else sourceDuration, else 5.

sourceDuration.description: Full length of the source audio, for a fixed-length clip.

startTime.description: Seconds from the start of the movie. Default 0.

title.description: Display label for the timeline clip.

url.description: Public URL to the audio file (mp3).

name: add_timeline_audio
title: Add an audio track to the timeline
